subjects.description: A pedestrian carrying a large flat rectangular mirror almost as tall as themselves, the reflective surface facing the ego vehicle so that it mirrors the road and sky and partially obscures the person's torso and head.
subjects.appearance_details: The mirror has a thin dark aluminum frame with a smooth, slightly reflective silver glass surface that catches the sunlight; the person's lower legs, jeans, and casual sneakers are visible below the mirror's edge, along with one hand gripping the frame.
subjects.relationship: Directly in the ego vehicle's driving path, functioning as an unexpected obstacle whose mirror surface deceives the vehicle's perception.
subjects.location: Center of frame, mid-distance, straddling the ego lane.
subjects.orientation: Facing toward the camera, the mirror surface angled squarely at the ego vehicle.
subjects.pose: Upright, walking laterally across the lane while carrying the mirror with both arms braced against its frame.
subjects.action: Walking across the ego lane holding the mirror upright toward the vehicle.
subjects.state_changes: Person advances steadily across the lane; the mirror's reflection of road and sky shifts slightly as the person moves, but the figure remains largely hidden behind the glass.
subjects.clothing: Casual light gray t-shirt partially visible above the mirror edge, blue denim jeans, and white sneakers.
subjects.skin_tone_and_texture: Medium tone visible only on gripping hands and lower legs

subjects.description: The large flat mirror itself, a distinct visual object reflecting the road and sky, creating a deceptive illusion of open lane.
subjects.appearance_details: Rectangular sheet of silvered glass in a slim dark frame, standing nearly the height of the person carrying it; its surface reflects the residential street, asphalt, curbs, and bright blue sky above.
subjects.relationship: Held by the pedestrian; the object that misleads the ego vehicle's perception into reading clear road ahead.
subjects.location: Center foreground-to-mid, blocking the direct path.
subjects.orientation: Reflective face angled directly at the camera.
subjects.pose: Held vertically, tilted very slightly backward.
subjects.action: Reflecting the road and sky toward the ego vehicle as it is carried across the lane.
subjects.state_changes: The reflected scene within the mirror grows larger and more detailed as the ego vehicle approaches, revealing the deception only at close range.

Sidewalks run parallel on both sides, and mailboxes and utility poles punctuate the roadside.
